Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) demonstrates a hypoplastic right lung with ipsilateral mediastinal shift (dextroposition of the heart) and a curvilinear opacity in the right lower zone (indicated by the arrow), which represents the anomalous pulmonary vein characteristic of Scimitar syndrome. The accompanying CT images confirm right-sided vascular and parenchymal anomalies consistent with this congenital condition.
